verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Gemini Notebook publishing an llms.txt file or agent-oriented documentation that an external agent could consume. Its ability to ingest websites and Markdown files as sources is a different feature: it is the product consuming content, not offering docs for agents, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
